reason: Internal /admin/config diagnostic note describing this shop's own X event-naming convention ("SWS prefixed events"). Not reusable brand copy; a clone would rewrite the note, not template it.

SWS_DOWNLOADS_URL is the literal env var NAME for the sws-downloads Cloudflare Worker (a separate sibling repo), referenced by that exact string in account.orders.$id.jsx and the Worker itself. Renaming it is a coordinated cross-repo change, not a brand.config.js value -- a clone can keep using this exact env var name unchanged.

TEST_DISCOUNT_PREFIX is an internal QA convention (a discount code prefixed SWSTEST marks a test order so it's excluded from ad conversions), not customer-facing brand text. A clone works identically keeping this exact prefix; renaming it buys nothing and risks breaking the verify:test-orders test fixtures that reference the same string.
